INSERT INTO job_attempts (
            job_id,
            run_number,
            attempt,
            worker_id,
            leased_at,
            started_at,
            claim_origin,
            execution_started_persisted_at
         )
         SELECT id, run_number, attempt, $2, now(), now(), $3, NULL
         FROM job_queue
         WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
